Tile logic for retrieving shred version, running an echo server, and publishing metrics.

# Purpose
`fd_tile_ipecho` defines a topology tile that discovers a shred version from entrypoints and then serves that value over a local network socket. The file combines an `fd_ipecho_client` for retrieval, an `fd_ipecho_server` for replies, and a `fd_stem` event loop to manage polling, fragment handling, and publication of the shred version into the stem pipeline. It also tracks server metrics and updates the `IPECHO` gauges and counters for connection count, bytes read, bytes written, and connection close results.

The file also defines the tile life cycle and runtime policy. [`privileged_init`](<#privileged_init>) allocates and initializes the client and server objects, [`unprivileged_init`](<#unprivileged_init>) binds the tile to the input workspace used to read the bootstrap completion fragment, and [`returnable_frag`](<#returnable_frag>) extracts the shred version from the `GENESI_SIG_BOOTSTRAP_COMPLETED` fragment and publishes it. The file sets file descriptor limits, seccomp rules, and allowed file descriptors for the tile, then exports the tile descriptor `fd_tile_ipecho` so the topology system can run it as a network-facing service.
